classes.depends-on-longitudinal-bootstrap: The edge's TARGET is in the `longitudinal` partition, which check-autogenesis-nursery.py pins to exactly the two Autogenesis-1 bootstrap lemmas. Re-derived by `class_complaint` in scripts/check-partition-edges.py from the live manifests; an amendment claiming it for a non-longitudinal target is reported and NOT honoured. Direction-specific on purpose: longitudinal -> evaluation is a leak and can never carry this class.

not_the_baseline: The 198 crossings that existed on 2026-09-02 were recorded in artifacts/autogenesis/partition-edge-baseline-v1.json and are the re-partition's to repair (ADR-1546 option 1). An amendment is for an edge somebody DECIDED to keep; the baseline is for an edge nobody has repaired yet. Do not move a row from one to the other to make a gate green -- the one class that has moved, `depends-on-longitudinal-bootstrap` (ADR-1563, 45 edges, baseline 198 -> 153), moved because the checker RE-DERIVES the property from the live manifests rather than reading a label, and because --record-baseline now excludes an honoured amendment, so deleting one makes its edge a violation again.
rule: An amendment names ONE EDGE and nothing else. Required fields: `from` (the fact whose depends_on carries the edge), `to` (the dependency it names), `reason`, `date`. Optional: `authority`. An element missing any required field is REPORTED AND NOT HONOURED -- a malformed amendment is a committed defect and reading it as absent is how an exemption list stops being reviewable.
why_not_a_component: ADR-1546 measured a component-shaped exemption re-scoped 228 -> 230 -> 258 -> 274 members in four days against a live component of 305, because a component grows whenever any member gains an edge. A fact-id SET says nothing about which edge was reviewed, so honouring one suppresses crossings nobody looked at. This gate refuses to read `cross_population_component_split_exemptions` (or `component_split_exemptions`) as an amendment and says so in its report; those entries keep whatever meaning they have for `check-autogenesis-nursery.py`, whose unit IS the component.
